name: Massachusetts placement assistant
description: Short intake, then streamed guidance — replaces the Typebot homepage embed with the same streaming behavior pattern.

steps.text: I’ll ask a few quick questions, then stream personalized Massachusetts assisted living / memory care guidance using our in-house assistant (no third-party chat embed).
Which town or ZIP in Massachusetts are you focused on (or “still deciding”)?
What level of care are you mainly exploring?
How soon are you hoping to move or decide?

steps.title: Your next steps
steps.text: Here is streamed guidance based on your answers (like Typebot’s streaming AI blocks):
items: Prepare tour questions about staffing, care-level fees, and discharge triggers before you visit.
Do you want to search by location, budget or care levels?
You may also ask to see data on staffing, citations and warnings for facilities.
